records.observation: Abstract InfoBox subclass. Five constructors delegate metadata initialization; exclusion=0 and nesting=1; copy variants copy parent reference but reset exclusion/nesting, other parent null. No row_ID assignment in displayed constructors; INVALID_ROW is MIN_INT and uninitialized predicate tests that sentinel. initExclusion sets duration then subtracts intersection duration for each supplied TimeBoundingBox independently; no union or nonnegative clamp. decrement subtracts directly. Nesting/row/parent setters/getters direct. Abstract primitive count/line IDs/vertices/draw/hit/search declarations. setStateRowAndNesting maps start vertex lineID to Integer row and delegates nesting factor to NestingStacks, without missing-map guard; xform argument unused in displayed body. drawOnCanvas dispatches event then state then arrow using category topology and color, otherwise logs and returns zero. getDrawableAt dispatches matching hit test, returns self on hit/null otherwise; unknown logs. Four static Drawable.Order objects wrap matching TimeBoundingBox order. No overlaps override declared here.

No null/type/overflow guards.
